ring.joinedBody: See the access links in Areas.

line.cannotOpen: A message this device can't open

reply.session: Session expired — open the app and sign in.
reply.noKey: The key isn't kept on this device — reply in the app.
reply.needPerson: A conversation needs a person — create one in the app.
reply.readOnly: In this conversation you only read.
reply.noPerson: The account doesn't run any person yet.

look.title: Notifications
look.waitingHint: What the bell and the Now page show — in this order. Switched-off kinds don't count towards the number at the bell.

push.notBuilt: Instant notifications: this version of the app doesn't support them — news arrives with the background check.
push.notServer: Instant notifications: the server doesn't send them yet — news arrives with the background check.
push.notPhone: Instant notifications: the phone hasn't registered yet (needs internet and Google services). Try restarting the app.
push.on: Instant notifications: on — a new message wakes the phone right away; the background check is only a backup.

content.notKept: While the app is open, the content is always visible. To see it and reply also with the app closed, switch on Account → Key: Kept on this phone. Without that, only the number of news arrives with the app closed.
content.session: The session on this phone has expired — sign in again so content returns to notifications{when}.
content.key: The phone couldn't open the key — open the app once with your password{when}.
content.failed: The last opening of content failed{when}; we'll try again with the next news.
content.ok: Content is decrypted only on this phone — Firebase carries only an empty signal. To reply from the notification, just type the text{when}.

settings.saveFailed: Could not save the device settings.
settings.label: Notification settings
settings.denied: Android didn't allow it. Switch on notifications for recreatio in the phone settings (Apps → recreatio → Notifications).
settings.enable: Switch on notifications on this device
settings.noBrowser: This browser doesn't show notifications — news is visible in the bell.
settings.contents: show who writes and what, names from submissions and task titles — with replies right from the notification
settings.lockScreen: On the lock screen Android shows only “New message” if hiding sensitive content is set in the phone settings.
settings.whenClosed: When the app is closed, check
settings.phoneHint: The phone checks only numbers (no content), only with internet and when the battery isn't nearly empty. Task reminders arrive on time even without this.
settings.browserHint: In the browser: every minute while the tab is in front (news then shows on the page), every 5 minutes in the background; less often on low battery. When the tab is closed there are no notifications — install the app on your phone to always get them.
settings.devices: Devices that check in the background
